name: 또도가스
motifs: Its two connected spherical shapes become unequal rounded shoulder armor lobes joined by a curved collar seam, with slim flexible hose-like piping worn as trim. Geyser-like protrusions become small blunt vent fins on plate edges. Purple and muted cream enamel surfaces. These are clothing shapes, never creature heads, floating balls or extra faces.
light: In a cool stone service hall, an adult woman in elegant dark-purple slim curved armor faces the camera in a stable three-quarter stance. Unequal rounded shoulder plates connected by curved collar trim, tiny vent ridges. Both empty open hands apart at hip level. Full body with clear feet and hair margins.
casual: At an empty historic railway platform on a misty morning, leaning her shoulder gently against a brick pillar, both arms down with open hands clearly in view, watching the empty tracks while her face remains visible. Entire woman and long compressed platform perspective.
Opaque plum sleeveless high-neck fitted top with cream tailored high-waisted short shorts and leather loafers. Bare arms and legs, tiny paired-circle pendant.

In a fashion atelier fitting alcove at warm evening, perched upright on a padded stool, feet apart naturally, one open hand on each separate side of the seat. Looking directly toward camera; warm side lamp and folded fabrics.

Fashion editorial lingerie-inspired outfit: opaque lined plum longline bustier with secure cups, high-waisted cream satin shorts and a sheer loose dressing robe resting around the elbows. Bare shoulders arms upper chest and thighs. No nudity, no transparent intimate panels.

At an empty glassblowing gallery workbench in crisp afternoon window light, carrying a finished cool glass bowl using opposite outer sides with widely separated hands. Side-on torso with head turned toward viewer, reflections and amber glass exhibits.
Opaque cream cross-wrap halter top tied securely behind the neck with plum fitted wide-leg trousers. Bare shoulders arms and upper back; tiny linked-circle bracelet. No armor.
